input: What is the policy for earned leaves?
expected_output:
Earned Leave (EL), also called Privilege Leave, is paid leave earned at a rate of **one day for every 20 days worked**—approximately **12 days per 240 working days annually**.

You may carry forward up to **30 days** of unused earned leave into the next year. Leave beyond this limit may be encashed annually or upon separation, subject to company policy. Leave requests should generally be submitted and approved in advance.
